## Titanic data

Consider the fitted model for the Titanic data:

Consider the model

$Survived_i \sim Bernoulli(\pi_i)$

$\log \left( \dfrac{\widehat{\pi}_i}{1 - \widehat{\pi}_i} \right) = 3.78 - 0.037 Age_i - 2.52 Male_i - 1.31 Class2_i - 2.58 Class3_i$


1. What is the estimated *probability* of survival for a male, first-class passenger aged 20? What about for a male, second-class passenger aged 30?

\vspace{4cm}

2. For each of these two passengers, do you predict they will survive or not? (That is, make a binary prediction -- a "yes" or "no" answer -- for each passenger)
